g: Weeks 1–6. Know every step with no video and no one to follow: Hannah's two videos, step by step, then the whole solo from memory on the counts (Nov 1). Knees over toes. No new tricks yet (Ms. Brittany: memorize first).
Weeks 7–9. Feet, knees, arms, eyes, one fix a week. Point + straighten on the floor work, long arms, high passé, trick preps look like dancing. Thanksgiving week (Nov 23) is light.
Weeks 10–14. A focal point for every section, two full-outs back to back, costume runs (Dec 14 week and Dec 28 week). Hold the ending to 2:00. Mandatory rehearsal Sat Jan 2.
Week 15. One run a day max. Nothing new, no deep stretching. Family mini show Thu Jan 7. Sleep. Winter Showcase Sat Jan 9.
Watch the Showcase video, pick two fixes. Press Play = classes only, rest after. Two clean runs before Hollywood Connection, no new corrections after Jan 19.
